svg.title: Прыжки через низкое препятствие — положение 1
svg.desc: Original ImageGen hollow contour, vector traced. Two-foot jump over a low ankle-to-shin-high training hurdle, true side view facing right. START both feet on floor immediately BEFORE hurdle, hips and knees gently bent, arms slightly back. FINISH at peak flight with both feet and knees in the air DIRECTLY ABOVE the same low horizontal hurdle bar, feet clearly higher than hurdle and floor, arms moving forward. Draw a simple real hurdle with visible side base, not a box. Expert biomechanics approval pending.
